notes: Manufacturer page confirms model AK-HRP1000GJ (the GJ suffix denotes the Japan/Asia region SKU; requested as "AK-HRP1000"). This is a 1/4-rack-size Remote Operation Panel (ROP) for Panasonic system/studio cameras — a desktop control surface, not conventionally rack-mounted, so rackUnits is omitted. Rear panel has exactly 3 cable connectors (confirmed from official product photo, labeled PREVIEW / CCU / LAN) plus an unlabeled chassis "SIGNAL GND" screw terminal, which is not included as a port since it's a ground lug, not a signal/power cable connector. The unit has NO dedicated AC/DC power inlet: it is powered either through the CCU connector (10–16V DC from a directly connected camera, or 16V DC when a CCU is in the chain) or through the LAN port via PoE+ (42–57V DC, requires a PoE+-capable switch and CAT5e-or-better cable, ≤100m). LAN Ethernet speed (e.g. 100M vs 1G) is not stated on the spec page, so no grade was set. The PREVIEW (4-pin) and CCU (7-pin) connectors are proprietary circular locking connectors (visually Hirose-style); "midi-din" was chosen only as the closest available connector id in the allowed list — it is not an actual MIDI DIN connector, and exact manufacturer part numbers were not found. Unit also has a front-panel SD card slot (firmware/scene-file storage) and a 3.5" LCD touch/joystick control surface, neither of which are cable I/O so they are omitted from the ports list.

ports.name: PREVIEW
ports.note: Proprietary 4-pin circular locking connector (Hirose-style), not a true MIDI DIN — closest available id. Likely outputs a composite preview-video feed to an external monitor; exact signal not documented on the spec sheet.

ports.name: CCU
ports.note: Proprietary 7-pin circular locking connector (Hirose-style), not a true MIDI DIN — closest available id. Carries camera/CCU serial control signals and also delivers DC power to the panel (12V DC from a directly-connected camera, or 16V DC when connected via a CCU). Max cable length 20 m (camera) / 50 m (CCU).
